backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing contact/appointment submission (public), admin-only domain draft management, access control with decommission mode, and user profile storage using Map data structures.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the removal of 'Doctor Suites' title from DoctorsPage component while preserving hero section, portraits, and CTA buttons.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration with details about routing, accessibility, forms, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with professional blue as primary brand color.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter Card tags, favicon links, and canonical URL for Mahalaxmi Health Care website.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt file allowing all crawlers to access all content and specifying sitemap location.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing all main pages (home, about, services, doctor-suites, contact, appointments) with priorities and change frequencies for SEO.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for all pages wrapped in SiteLayout, including 404 handling.
frontend/src/components/forms/Appointmen: Accessible appointment request form with validation, department selection dropdown (including diagnostic services), loading states, success/error feedback using shadcn-ui components and React Query mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/forms/ContactFor: A contact form component with validation, submission handling via useSubmitContact hook, and success/error alerts. Includes fields for name, contact info, subject, and message with accessibility attributes.
A hero section component with configurable variants (default, gradient, pattern), supporting title, subtitle, badge, and children. Applies cache-busting to pattern background images.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeroI: An image component for hero sections with error handling, cache-busting for generated assets, and a fallback UI with refresh instructions when images fail to load.
frontend/src/components/layout/Section.t: A simple section wrapper component with default and muted variants, providing consistent padding and container styling.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: The site footer displaying hospital branding with logo, contact details, hours, quick links, and build version. Includes error handling for logo loading.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: The site header with emergency contact bar, logo, desktop/mobile navigation, and search button. Manages mobile menu state and active route highlighting.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: The main layout wrapper combining SiteHeader, SiteFooter, and SeoManager with skip-to-content link for accessibility.
frontend/src/components/seo/Organization: Renders JSON-LD structured data for the medical organization to help search engines understand the business entity.
frontend/src/components/seo/SeoManager.t: Dynamically updates document head tags (title, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph, Twitter Card, Google verification) based on current route.
frontend/src/config/branding.ts: Centralized hospital branding configuration exporting HOSPITAL_NAME constant and getPageTitle helper function.
frontend/src/config/buildInfo.ts: Provides build ID and version information for cache-busting and version display, using VITE_BUILD_ID environment variable.
frontend/src/config/contactDetails.ts: Centralized contact details configuration with phone, email, address, hours, and helper functions for emergency and main phone tel links.
frontend/src/config/seo.ts: Defines SEO configuration including default meta tags, route-specific titles/descriptions, and helper functions for generating page metadata and canonical URLs for the hospital website.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, automatically recreating it when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDomainDraft.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving domain draft content, with automatic cache invalidation on successful saves.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality with delegation identity management and configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitAppointmentR: React Query mutation hook for submitting appointment requests to the backend actor with error normalization for better UX.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitContact.ts: React Query mutation hook for submitting contact form data to the backend actor with error handling and normalization.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a professional hospital color palette (blue primary, teal secondary, orange accents) for both light and dark modes, plus accessibility enhancements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page component displaying hospital mission, vision, core values, and facility images using hero sections, cards, and responsive grid layouts.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentRequestPag: Displays an appointment booking page with a hero section, consultation room images, a three-step process explanation, and an embedded AppointmentRequestForm component.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Renders a contact page with hero image, reception photo, contact information cards (phone, email, location, hours), and a ContactForm component.
frontend/src/pages/DecommissionedPage.ts: Shows a maintenance notice page indicating a service is temporarily unavailable, with warning icons and placeholder images.
frontend/src/pages/DoctorsPage.tsx: Presents the medical team with hero images, doctor portraits, and call-to-action buttons for booking appointments or contacting the clinic.
frontend/src/pages/DomainDraftPage.tsx: Provides an authenticated admin interface for managing domain configuration drafts with save/load functionality using Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page featuring a hero section with stats, service cards, emergency contact information, and organization JSON-LD schema for SEO.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Custom 404 error page with navigation illustrations and a button to return to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: React component that displays a comprehensive list of medical services offered by the healthcare facility, including emergency services, specialties, and diagnostic services, with a hero section and service cards featuring icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/utils/generatedAssets.ts: Utility functions for detecting generated assets and adding cache-busting version parameters to their URLs using build IDs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for parsing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, extended spacing, shadows, and typography plugins for the frontend application.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking existing features, architectural notes, and known issues; currently contains one completed feature for removing 'Doctor Suites' title from the DoctorsPage component.
